name: Hilkiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Before talking about Lazarus and the lake of fire, these scriptures lead up to it. This chapter is talking about a servant named Eliakim: “I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah”. Eliakim the son of Hilkiah is symbolic for the coming Messiah, whom the world calls Christ.
